name: useToast
purpose: React hook for accessing the ToastController supplied by ToastProvider.

guidance.useWhen: Use inside a ToastProvider subtree to enqueue, update, or dismiss transient toast feedback.
guidance.avoidWhen: Do not call outside ToastProvider; the hook throws when no provider is present, and it is not a persistent-message API.
guidance.aiUsageNotes: Call only within ToastProvider; use the returned controller for toast/success/error/warning/info/update/dismiss operations.

accessibility: The hook renders no DOM; accessibility semantics are provided by the ToastProvider viewport and rendered Toast records.
knownLimitations: Avoid required validation, persistent alerts, destructive confirmation, and notification history.
